title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.cpp and report.tex:36–45 describe conservative perfect-gas Euler/NS equations and viscosity/heat conduction.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Mesh.cpp CGNS elements/geometry and DistributedMesh.cpp root METIS partition, owned/ghost cells; serial and np2 tests pass.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp computes face conservative inviscid and viscous contributions; global norms are reduced; independent spatial test passes.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Submitted Physics.cpp implements Rusanov local LF numerical flux; finite dissipation and entropy treatment differ from Roe-type alternatives.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Reconstruction boundary functions implement characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic states; Solver.cpp:279–316 emits actual wall boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Limited least-squares reconstruction with startup ramp Solver.cpp:354–356; at M2 inviscid step2120 final-source factor0.56, not full. Historical executable unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.cpp implements Barth–Jespersen limiter and density/pressure physical-state guards; exact activation counts not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp:31–45,165–179 uses projected tangential wall shear and report describes it; M015 viscous Cd is anomalously large versus peers.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Distributed LU-SGS implemented, but Solver.cpp:31–44 absolute 0.02 force window admits an M2 final1000 drag decline of33%, contrary to claimed stability.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Solver.cpp:354–403 includes full physical BDF residual; report explicitly permits advance at maximum and metadata lists108/30000 target misses. Re200 validator OOM-unverified; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root preprocessing and neighbour halo exchange are source-backed; two-rank mesh/halo tests pass; rank force comparisons do not establish DQ4.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
